name: EMA9x21 Cross + RSI Filter
idea_text: 9 EMA crosses above 21 EMA and RSI is above 50 -> buy; opposite crossover with RSI below 50 -> sell

name: BB + RSI Reversal
idea_text: Overbought/oversold reversal: sell when price closes above the upper Bollinger Band and RSI > 70, buy when price closes below the lower Bollinger Band and RSI < 30
